 Dear Sir/Madam, 
Subject: Audio Recording link of Conference Call with investors and analysts held on 
October 26, 2026 
This is with reference to our intimation dated 21st October 2026 regarding Conference Call 
with investors and analysts scheduled on Monday, 26th October 2026 at 5:00 PM (IST) to 
discuss the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 
30th September 2026. 
 
In terms of the provisions of Regulations 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find the link for the audio recording of the above 
concall held, as under: 
https://media.aplapollo.com/files/Q2_Earnings_Conference_Call_FY%E2%80%9927.mp3. 
We request you to kindly take the above information on your records. 
Thanking you 
 
Yours faithfully 
 
For APL Apollo Tubes Limited 
 
 
 
Vipul Jain

Compliance Officer
